title: Canon research-fields cap
description: THE research cap (SP-20260525-022, β Q4 conf 0.83). The canon engine may invoke research:* ONLY to fill the named fields enumerated here — never open-ended discovery. The engine builds its research query set from these field names, and validates the research response against this schema. additionalProperties:false at every level is the bound: a research backend returning fields outside this set is rejected (its extra output is discarded, not silently merged). Every filled field MUST carry a `sources[]` (citations); a field with no sources is treated as THIN (validation WARNING, never a silent pass — per β's before_execute directive).

per_doc.description: Research-fillable fields keyed by canonical doc. The engine only researches docs whose intent input is thin.

research_cap.description: Hard caps on the research phase, enforced by the engine.

fieldSet.description: A bounded set of named research findings for one canonical doc. Only the field names listed in this doc's x-fields are permitted as keys under `findings`.

findings.description: Map of named-field -> value. Keys MUST be drawn from the doc's x-fields list (the engine enforces). Each value is a short synthesized finding.

sources.description: Citations backing the findings. EMPTY sources => the findings are THIN => validation WARNING (never a silent pass).
